name: Old El Paso Traditional Refried Beans (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Pinto beans mashed with lard, salt, and onion powder. High in indigestible oligosaccharide fructans and bean skins that produce severe colonic fermentation and painful gas spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID. For Mexican night, enjoy plain white rice and shredded chicken in soft flour tortillas.
